title: Glazing Fitting & Delivery App | On-Site Sign-Off | Coglass
description: Record fitting and delivery on site — per-pane completion, photos, GPS proof and customer signature. Snags and partial fits logged with reasons, so the office knows exactly what’s left.
lead: Fitters tick off each pane on site with photos, GPS and a customer signature. Snags and partial fits are logged with reasons, so the office knows exactly what’s left to go back for.
steps_h2: Close the job out properly, on site
steps_sub: Coglass turns a finished fitting into clean proof — and tells the office exactly what’s outstanding.
inc_h2: Everything you need to finish a job
inc_sub: Built for the last, most important step — getting signed off and getting paid.
steps: The fitter opens the booked visit in the app — the full glass list, drawings and access notes from the survey are already there.
Mark every item Fitted, Partly or Not fitted. “All fitted” clears a clean job in one tap.
Not fitted or partly fitted? Pick a reason — wrong size, scratched, broken in transit and more. If the glass needs replacing, Coglass flags the pane for re-order.
Attach installation photos and snag notes against each item so the office sees exactly what happened.
The customer signs on the phone to confirm completion — stored against the job with GPS and time.
When every pane is fitted, the job moves to completed and a draft invoice is created automatically for the office to send.
included: Per-item completion
Fitted, Partly or Not fitted on every pane — not just a single “done” for the whole job.
All fitted
Clean job? One tap marks every item fitted.
Reasons for anything not fitted
Wrong size, scratched, broken in transit, awaiting materials, access problem and more — a reason is needed before the job can be finished.
Re-order flagging
Panes that need new glass send the office a notification and keep the job in Needs attention until it is re-booked.
Installation photos
Photos per item and per visit, stored against the order.
Snag notes
Record snags and make-good notes for follow-up visits.
Customer signature
Digital signature capture confirming completion on site.
GPS & time proof
Location and timestamp recorded for arrival, departure and sign-off.
Partial fit tracking
Outstanding panes keep the order open so nothing is forgotten.
Delivery proof
Delivery visits captured with proof photo and GPS.
Auto-invoice on completion
A draft invoice is raised the moment the job completes.
Offline-first
Sign-offs captured with no signal and synced automatically later.
Mark it done from the office
For staff who don’t use the app, the office can mark a job fitted, delivered or collected from the order page.

stories.label: When it doesn’t all go in
stories.h2: Short fits, extra work and signed hand-overs
stories.sub: The awkward part of fitting is the pane that didn’t go in. Coglass makes sure the office hears about it before the customer rings.

items.title: The fitting re-order
items.problem: A unit is the wrong size or arrives scratched. The fitter tells someone in the yard, the re-order waits for a quiet moment, and the customer waits longer.
items.fix: The fitter marks the pane Not fitted and picks a reason. If the reason means new glass — wrong size, scratched, broken — the pane is flagged for re-order and the office gets a notification.
see: “Office will re-order this pane” on the fitter’s screen
The job stays open, at the top of Needs attention with a Re-order badge, until it is re-booked
Everything else on the job recorded as fitted, with photos

items.title: Extra work found on site
items.problem: The fitter spots another cracked pane while they are there. It gets mentioned in the van and forgotten.
items.fix: In the phone app, Extra job at this site makes a new job for the same customer with a description and photos — with or without signal.
see: A new job for the office to quote, for the same customer
Sent by itself once the phone has signal again

items.title: Signed collection notes
items.problem: A trade customer collects, then rings next week to say the third pane was never there — and all you have is a scribble in a book.
items.fix: On the shop-floor iPad, Hand over opens a signing screen. The customer signs, you type the name of the person collecting, and for account customers take their photo.
see: A signed collection note listing every item, with the signature and photo
Emailed to the order’s contact straight away, and kept on the job’s Documents tab
The office can record a collection from the order page too, and email the proof
